STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_221140.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_221140.v · Open raw
module origen_221140(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input tbre,
    input tsre,
    input data_ready,
    input [1:0] mode,
    input [7:0] data_to_send,
    inout [7:0] ram1_data,
    output reg rdn,
    output reg wrn,
    output reg ram1_oe,
    output reg ram1_we,
    output reg ram1_en,
    output reg [7:0] led,
    output reg [7:0] leddebug
);

reg [2:0] state, next_state;
reg [7:0] recv_val;
reg bus_written;

parameter WRITE = 2'b00, READ = 2'b01, SYNTHESIS = 2'b10;

always @(posedge clk, negedge rst) begin
    if (!rst) begin
        state <= 3'b000;
    end else begin
        state <= next_state;
    end
end

always @(*) begin
    case (state)
        3'b000: begin // IDLE
            if (mode == WRITE) begin
                next_state = 3'b001; // WRITE
            end else if (mode == READ) begin
                next_state = 3'b010; // READ
            end else if (mode == SYNTHESIS) begin
                next_state = 3'b011; // SYNTHESIS
            end else begin
                next_state = 3'b000; // IDLE
            end
        end
        3'b001: begin // WRITE
            if (tbre && tsre) begin
                next_state = 3'b000; // IDLE
            end else begin
                next_state = 3'b001; // WRITE
            end
        end
        3'b010: begin // READ
            if (data_ready) begin
                next_state = 3'b000; // IDLE
            end else begin
                next_state = 3'b010; // READ
            end
        end
        3'b011: begin // SYNTHESIS
            if (data_ready) begin
                next_state = 3'b000; // IDLE
            end else begin
                next_state = 3'b011; // SYNTHESIS
            end
        end
        default: begin
            next_state = 3'b000; // IDLE
        end
    endcase
end

always @(posedge clk, negedge rst) begin
    if (!rst) begin
        rdn <= 1'b1;
        wrn <= 1'b1;
        ram1_oe <= 1'b0;
        ram1_we <= 1'b0;
        ram1_en <= 1'b0;
        led <= 8'b0;
        leddebug <= 8'b0;
        recv_val <= 8'b0;
        bus_written <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: begin // IDLE
                rdn <= 1'b1;
                wrn <= 1'b1;
                ram1_oe <= 1'b0;
                ram1_we <= 1'b0;
                ram1_en <= 1'b0;
                bus_written <= 1'b0;
            end
            3'b001: begin // WRITE
                rdn <= 1'b1;
                wrn <= 1'b0;
                ram1_oe <= 1'b0;
                ram1_we <= 1'b1;
                ram1_en <= 1'b1;
                bus_written <= 1'b1;
            end
            3'b010: begin // READ
                rdn <= 1'b0;
                wrn <= 1'b1;
                ram1_oe <= 1'b1;
                ram1_we <= 1'b0;
                ram1_en <= 1'b1;
                recv_val <= ram1_data;
                led <= recv_val;
                bus_written <= 1'b1;
            end
            3'b011: begin // SYNTHESIS
                rdn <= 1'b0;
                wrn <= 1'b0;
                ram1_oe <= 1'b1;
                ram1_we <= 1'b1;
                ram1_en <= 1'b1;
                recv_val <= ram1_data;
                led <= recv_val + 1;
                bus_written <= 1'b1;
            end
            default: begin
                rdn <= 1'b1;
                wrn <= 1'b1;
                ram1_oe <= 1'b0;
                ram1_we <= 1'b0;
                ram1_en <= 1'b0;
                bus_written <= 1'b0;
            end
        endcase

        leddebug <= {3'b0, state, recv_val[4:0]};
    end
end

assign ram1_data = bus_written ? (state == 3'b001 ? data_to_send : (state == 3'b011 ? (recv_val + 1) : 8'bz)) : 8'bz;

endmodule
